===== airport_connections.vl.json [zero shapes] =====
// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/us-10m.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  // vl2plot: unsupported mark type "geoshape", skipped (--ignore-unsupported)
  let chartData2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/flights-airport.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  chartData2 = chartData2.filter(d => true /* vl2d3: unsupported filter predicate shape {"param":"org","empty":false}, keeping every row (--ignore-unsupported) */);
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  let chartData3 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/flights-airport.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  chartData3 = Array.from(d3.rollup(chartData3, rows => ({"origin": rows[0]["origin"], "routes": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["origin"]])).values());
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  chartData3 = chartData3.filter(d => d.state !== 'PR' && d.state !== 'VI');
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    width: 900,
    height: 500,
    r: {legend: null},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX(chartData2, {}),
      Plot.dot(chartData3, {
    r: "routes",
  }),
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.csv(new URL("data/airports.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  let chartData2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/airports.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  let chartData3 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/airports.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    width: 500,
    height: 300,
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(chartData, {
    fill: "gray",
    r: 1,
  }),
      Plot.dot(chartData2, {
    fill: "steelblue",
    r: 1,
  }),
      Plot.dot(chartData3, {
    fill: "firebrick",
    r: 1,
  }),
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

  chartData2 = chartData2.map(d => ({...d, "bLabel": ((d.name).indexOf(' ') > 0  ? String(d.name).substring(0, (d.name).indexOf(' ')) : d.name)}));

    document: container.ownerDocument,

      domain: [

        "DLR",
        "Hammersmith & City",
        "Jubilee",
        "Metropolitan",
        "Northern",
        "Piccadilly",
        "Victoria",
        "Waterloo & City",

        "rgb(137,78,36)",

        "rgb(255,206,0)",
        "rgb(1,114,41)",

        "rgb(215,153,175)",
        "rgb(106,114,120)",
        "rgb(114,17,84)",
        "rgb(0,0,0)",
        "rgb(0,24,168)",
        "rgb(0,160,226)",
        "rgb(106,187,170)",
      ],
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.text(chartData2, {
    text: "bLabel",
    opacity: 0.6,

    ],

===== histogram_rel_freq.vl.json [zero shapes] =====
// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  chartData = d3.bin().value(d => d["Horsepower"]).thresholds(20)(chartData).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_Horsepwoer": bin.x0, "bin_Horsepwoer_end": bin.x1})));
  chartData = Array.from(d3.rollup(chartData, rows => ({"bin_Horsepwoer": rows[0]["bin_Horsepwoer"], "bin_Horsepwoer_end": rows[0]["bin_Horsepwoer_end"], "Count": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["bin_Horsepwoer"], d["bin_Horsepwoer_end"]])).values());
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "joinaggregate" (--ignore-unsupported)
  chartData = chartData.map(d => ({...d, "PercentOfTotal": (d.Count/d.TotalCount)}));
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    marks: [
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const wrapper = container.ownerDocument.createElement('div');
  wrapper.style.display = 'flex';
  wrapper.style.flexDirection = 'column';
  wrapper.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
  wrapper.style.gap = '1em';
  let chart1Data = await d3.json(new URL("data/us-10m.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  // vl2plot: unsupported mark type "geoshape", skipped (--ignore-unsupported)
  let chart1Data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/flights-airport.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  chart1Data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(chart1Data2, rows => ({"origin": rows[0]["origin"], "routes": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["origin"]])).values());
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  chart1Data2 = chart1Data2.filter(d => d.state !== 'PR' && d.state !== 'VI');
  const chartNode1 = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    width: 500,
    height: 300,
    r: {legend: null},
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(chart1Data2, {
    fill: "steelblue",
    r: "routes",
  }),
    ],
  });
  wrapper.appendChild(chartNode1);
  // vl2plot: 'repeat' composition is not yet supported, rendering an empty panel (--ignore-unsupported)
  const chartNode2 = Plot.plot({document: container.ownerDocument, marks: []});
  wrapper.appendChild(chartNode2);
  container.appendChild(wrapper);
  return wrapper;
}

  chartData = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(chartData).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_IMDB_Rating": bin.x0, "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": bin.x1})));

  chartData = chartData.filter(d => d.bin_IMDB_Rating !== null);
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "sort" (--ignore-unsupported)

  chartData2 = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(chartData2).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_IMDB_Rating": bin.x0, "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": bin.x1})));

  chartData2 = chartData2.filter(d => d.bin_IMDB_Rating !== null);
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "sort" (--ignore-unsupported)
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    marks: [
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

    document: container.ownerDocument,
    marks: [
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

===== trail_comet.vl.json [zero shapes] =====
// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/barley.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "pivot" (--ignore-unsupported)
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "fold" (--ignore-unsupported)
  chartData = chartData.map(d => ({...d, "year": (Number(d.year))}));
  chartData = chartData.map(d => ({...d, "delta": (d['1932'] - d['1931'])}));
  // vl2plot: unsupported mark type "trail", skipped (--ignore-unsupported)
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    color: {domainMid: 0},
    r: {range: [0, 12]},
    marks: [
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}
